newsitem.title: USA: U.N. head urges more education programs.
newsitem.headline: U.N. head urges more education programs.

text.p: United Nations Secretary General Kofi Annan said Monday that U.S. educators should give students more information to help erase widespread misunderstanding of the world body's role.
"Some people have lost faith in the U.N.," Annan told the American Council on Education, a group of U.S. university and college leaders.

"Students have very little information...and many students enter college without the rudimentary knowledge of the United Nations," Annan said, urging the audience to inform their students about U.N. activities.
He said the United Nations planned to sponsor a conference next year on the changing role of higher education around the world and how to provide students with more useful programmes.

A poll by the Wirthlin group last year found that 64 percent of Americans supported paying dues to the United Nations. At the same time, politicians routinely criticise the world body and its operations.
